messages.author: 55510d3aabca3a87
messages.subject: gheatmap - multiple colours in matrix
parts:
Hi All,

Just wondering if it is possible to have different colour in the columns of the heatmap and is it possible to specify the colour through column number?
For example a heatmap with red in the first three cols [1:3] followed by three columns of green [4:6] and three columns of blue [7:9]. 

Thanks

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: gheatmap - multiple colours in matrix
parts: Of course it is possible, the color depends on the values inside each cells. For example if your data contains discrete values and the first columns are all for example 'A', follow by another three columns of 'B', etc. If your data is in such format, you can make the heatmap you want.
